# Pipeline Sprint

## What it does
- Our team builds the list, writes the sequence and runs outbound for 6 weeks
- Weekly results call with the reply data by segment

## Facts we can state
- 6-week fixed program
- Includes 3 sending domains and 9 warmed mailboxes
- Ends with a playbook the client keeps

## Who it is for
- Founders and first sales leaders who need pipeline before they hire SDRs
